checks.text: firefox held at 158.0 brings its own glibc 2.42; the system's Mesa/Wayland drivers are built against glibc 2.44. The program is self-contained but can fail to find a GL/EGL driver at run time (seen with dorion 2026-10-11). Prefer nixin update --to 1d06008 for everything, or expect to wrap it with the pinned Mesa
a second nixpkgs tree (2 pinned revisions) adds about 1-2 s and 300 MiB to every evaluation; after a garbage collection nix re-downloads it (~60 s)
out-of-tree modules are built with the new nixpkgs' toolchain against the held kernel; vermagic is by version, so they load. A compiler-version complaint means: nixin pin kernel --whole-set
pin "kernel" holds nothing yet: flake.lock is still at 3ec6363, the revision it pins; it takes effect once the lock moves (nixin update)
